verdict: Netflix added a record 18.9M subscribers in a single quarter — powered by Squid Game 2, the NFL Christmas games and the Paul–Tyson fight — lifting revenue 16% to $10.2B and nearly doubling net income to $1.9B.

Regional revenues are from the shareholder letter's regional breakdown.

takeaways.title: The biggest subscriber quarter ever
takeaways.text: Netflix added 18.91M paid memberships in three months — its largest quarter on record — taking the total past 300M to 301.6M, powered by Squid Game season 2, two NFL Christmas Day games and the Paul–Tyson boxing event.

takeaways.title: Profit grew three times faster than revenue
takeaways.text: Operating income rose 52% YoY to $2.3B on revenue growth of 16% — the operating margin reached 22%, and net income nearly doubled to $1.9B.

takeaways.title: A cash-rich year
takeaways.text: Free cash flow was $1.4B in the quarter and $7.4B for 2024 as a whole, and Netflix announced a further $15B share-buyback authorization alongside the results.
